Garage description
The paint combines the masking properties of sand, with wind-tempered stone. The "Sandstone" set comes bundled with bathing trunks or bikini of choice, sunglasses and a parasol.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on August 26, 2010.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Sandstone was worth 82,500 crystals and was purchasable at the rank of First Lieutenant.
Legacy paint description:
A multifunctional paint that reduces the damage inflicted by Twins, Railgun, Thunder and Shaft. Works well in mid to long- range battles. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
